timeline.author: Nhat Nguyen

timeline.body: We don't send empty blocks into Operators at this point anyway.

It looks right to me. I think we should grow an `OrdinalsGroupingOperatorTests` at some point soon. It's much easier to debug problems building with it. And it's runs the CrankyBreaker which is much better at finding weird failures when building than I am by hand. I think you've covered them all with the `try` blocks you have, but it's hard for me to know without the test.

> I think we should grow an OrdinalsGroupingOperatorTests at some point soon

++. I will do this in a follow-up.
